Staff.title: Staff
Staff.description: Represents a staff member with their details and schedule information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Staff entity.

name.description: The full name of the staff member.

calendarId.description: Identifier for the staff member's associated calendar.

colorKey.description: Color key associated with the staff member's calendar for visual representation.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer with their contact and location information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Customer entity.

name.description: The full name of the customer.

address.description: The physical address of the customer.

WorkSchedule.title: WorkSchedule
WorkSchedule.description: Represents a work schedule entry, linking staff, location, and time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the WorkSchedule entity.

startTime.description: The start time of the work schedule.

endTime.description: The end time of the work schedule.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Represents a work location with its address and geographical coordinates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Location entity.

address.description: The address of the work location.

latitude.description: The latitude coordinate of the work location.

longitude.description: The longitude coordinate of the work location.

EmployeeAction.title: EmployeeAction
EmployeeAction.description: Represents an action performed by an employee during the workday.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EmployeeAction entity.

actionType.description: The type of action performed (e.g., Arrive, BeginTask, FinishTask, Depart).

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the action was performed.

workScheduleId.description: Reference to WorkSchedule. (Relationship: WorkSchedule 1:N EmployeeAction). The schedule that the action relates to.
